title: Eastron SDM120-M Single-Phase Energy Meter
description: Baseline model for the Eastron SDM120-M (ordered as SDM120-Modbus) single-phase two-wire DIN-rail energy meter with a 45 A direct connection, read over RS-485 Modbus RTU; it applies to meters that report meter code 0x0020 (32) in holding register 0xFC02. The software version is not stated; the meter reports it in holding register 0xFC84. Register map: Eastron SDM120-M User Manual V1.0 (2025), Modbus register Map, PDF pages 11-14: input registers read with function code 04, holding registers with function code 03. The map gives each value's start address, which this model uses as the zero-based address (register 30001 is start address 0x0000). Values are IEEE 754 32-bit floats, or signed 64-bit integers in the counter block at 0x2710, in consecutive registers. The manual does not state the word order, and no meter was read on hardware: the model reads the high word first, the Modbus default, and the first reading on a real meter must confirm it. The manual states no limit on the request size and no address ranges that may be read together, so every point or run of contiguous points is its own acquisition group. The SDM120-M User Manual V1.1 (2026) covers the SDM120-M(MB) and has no register map. Left out: the configuration holding registers (demand period, pulse width, rate and output mode, parity and stop bits, meter ID, baud rate, display scroll time, CO2 rate, measurement mode), the write-only reset of historical data, the serial number, which is instance data, and the second block of scaled 32-bit integer registers at 0x280A-0x2846 (voltage, current, powers, power factor, frequency and carbon emissions in units of 0.1 to 0.001), which repeats values the float registers carry and which the catalog's simulation check cannot serve at the type range limits.
